answer.reason: Mahanaim is the scene of several events: Jacob's naming of it, Ishbosheth's crowning there, and David's stay there.

clauses.english: was where Jacob saw God's host and named the place
clauses.quote: This is God's host: and he called the name of that place Mahanaim.

clauses.english: was where Abner brought Ishbosheth and made him king over Israel
clauses.quote: took Ishbosheth the son of Saul, and brought him over to Mahanaim;

clauses.english: was where David came and was given food and supplies
clauses.quote: when David was come to Mahanaim

doubts: SNG 6:13 (the Shulamite, 'company of two armies') was left out because it may not refer to the place.
Verses that only list Mahanaim as a Gadite or Levite city, a boundary, or a district of Solomon were left out.
